added.text: FAQs
Isn't Peloton just an exercise bike company?
No, Peloton offers 10+ types of exercises, grouped into disciplines, across cycling, running, strength, yoga, pilates, and more.
Peloton’s thousands of workout classes are available live and on-demand on the Peloton App, accessible from your phone, TV, or tablet, no equipment required.
You can also access the library of live and on-demand workouts from the Peloton Bike, Bike+, Tread, Tread+, or Row.
Can you use the Peloton App with any bike, treadmill, or rower?
You can use the Peloton App with any bike, treadmill, or rower.
We offer two membership tiers, based on your workout routine:
Get access to 3 cardio equipment classes per month with a Peloton App One membership
Get unlimited access cardio classes with a Peloton App+ membership.
Both App membership tiers offer unlimited access to Peloton’s strength, yoga, and floor workouts.
How much is the Peloton App?
We currently offer two membership tiers for the Peloton App:

Peloton App One ($0/mo) - unlimited access to strength, yoga, meditation, outdoor running, and gym workouts, plus 3 cardio equipment classes per month to take on any exercise bike, treadmill, or rower.
Peloton App+ ($0/mo) - unlimited access to cardio classes for any exercise bike, treadmill, or rower, alongside the workouts you can access through App One.
Can the Peloton App help me learn how to make a successful workout plan?
The Peloton App can help you build a successful workout plan with personalized recommendations, progress tracking, and motivating instructors who help you stay committed.
Keep your routine fresh with thousands of workouts, across 15+ workout types and 55+ instructors, and find what’s right for your goals, schedule, and style.
Does the Peloton App have a place where I can keep my workout routine?
Plan your routine by bookmarking classes, creating playlists of classes you’re interested in, and scheduling your week of workouts.
See and track your progress over time, as you hit PRs, milestones, and more.
Explore tips to build and stick to your routine .
How do I start working out with the Peloton App?
Download the Peloton App here or from the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and start your 30-day free trial.
Get started with easy onboarding that helps you find the right first class and Instructor for you.
From there, explore features that help make it easy to plan and take workouts, and discover new ways to sweat.
Find more tips on how to get started .
